entities.name: Chaza Isles
entities.description: Tropical islands off Zhalfir and Buleusi Bay on the Jaema Sea, hiding Teferi's Isle.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Land whose coasts the Chaza Isles fan out from; later a plane.

entities.name: Teferi's Isle
entities.description: Remote atoll where Teferi performed time experiments.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who experimented with time manipulation and phased out Teferi's Isle and Zhalfir.

entities.name: Phasing of Teferi's Isle
entities.description: Event in which everything on the isle was removed from the time stream.

entities.name: Mirage Wars
entities.description: War indirectly caused by the phasing.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Teferi phased Zhalfir out.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which the isles were returned.

events.summary: Teferi's time experiments go haywire, phasing Teferi's Isle out of the time stream and attracting Jolrael, Mangara and Kaervek.
events.quote: thus indirectly causing the Mirage Wars

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion Teferi phases Zhalfir out, with the Chaza Isles and parts of northwestern Jamuraa.
Jeska destroys the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void, forever losing the isles from Dominaria.
events.quote: They were forever lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroyed the time rift

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion the phased-out isles are returned and now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
events.quote: They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir

relations.note: Now part of the plane of Zhalfir.
relations.quote: They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir
